name: model_api
summary: The single proprietary API surface external apps reach AFTER passing through freetier_gate token verification. Wraps cloud_providers + deepseek_mcp + hf_hub behind one HTTP server on port 8521 (env override MSPC_MODEL_API_PORT). Endpoints: POST /v1/text/generate, /v1/code/generate, /v1/embed; GET /v1/providers and /v1/healthz. OpenAI-compatible request shape (prompt OR messages). Bearer auth via freetier_gate.verify_token reading Authorization header. Caller identity (user_id, domain, tier from TokenClaims) propagates into every response AND every crystal chain entry — providing per-tenant audit. Falls back across cloud_providers.pick candidates (up to 4 attempts). Every successful call crystal-anchors with tier='model_api', model='<resolved provider>'.
engine_pattern: Stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer. ModelAPI class for in-process callers (no HTTP). HTTP handlers verify token first, parse JSON body, dispatch through ModelAPI.text/code/embed which iterate cloud_providers.pick fallback ladder. Per-attempt latency + status recorded in the response.mspc.attempts array.

env_vars.MODEL_API_LOG: set to 'quiet' to suppress access log

inbound_callers: External apps the operator sells (Replit-deployed, dApp, etc.)
Godot apps after acquiring a freetier token via the callback flow
routing_connections.substrate_writes: InferenceRecord per call + access log to stderr

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.code_via_bearer: ok — deepseek-coder 'Python lambda squaring int' → valid Python (12in/?out tokens) latency 983ms, crystal d6c63984c8bf91513b23a000
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.caller_propagation: ok — TokenClaims (user_id, domain, tier) flow into response.mspc.caller AND crystal chain entry's source_file=caller=<id>@<domain>

guarantees: Bearer-gated — no API call proceeds without freetier_gate.verify_token returning valid claims
OpenAI-compatible — any OpenAI SDK can call /v1/text/generate by pointing baseURL at this server
Crystal-audit-trail — every call has a deterministic chain entry tying caller → provider → response
Fallback-resilient — up to 4 candidates from cloud_providers.pick tried before reporting 502
Single-port — one stdlib server; no FastAPI dep
Caller-aware accounting — tier from token can be used for rate limits (future)
Per-caller audit — caller={user_id, domain, tier} written into source_file claim
Graceful degradation — provider failures recorded in response.mspc.attempts[]
future_v2_hooks: Per-caller rate limiting based on TokenClaims.tier
Streaming via Server-Sent Events for text/code endpoints
Cache short-circuit via result_cache before provider dispatch
usage_example:
# In-process:
from model_api import ModelAPI
api = ModelAPI()
result = api.text('Hello', max_tokens=64)
print(result.output, result.crystal)

# HTTP (after acquiring token via callback):
curl -X POST http://localhost:8521/v1/text/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <freetier_token>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":50}'
